Quick update from finance side: moving a customer to AWS Marketplace usually preserves the customer's existing Net terms (Net 30 / Net 45) in our contract template, but the marketplace payment flow can introduce a ~7-10 day settlement lag from AWS side before we receive funds. Practically that means we cannot shorten their terms via marketplace; we can, however, offer a short credit/settlement offset in the first invoice cycle to keep their cashflow neutral if they need it.

I've attached a sample invoice (Redwood-invoice-sample.pdf) showing marketplace line items and how co-sell credits appear. I recommend we: 
- Offer a one-time "settlement credit" equal to one invoice cycle if they need Net 30 preserved in cash flow.
- Confirm PO name exactly as Suresh provided before we push entitlement changes.

Laura — once we have the final PO name and AP email I can pre-config the accounting mapping and prepare the credit note template.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
